0029 — Cut scanner complexity by extracting the line masker and replacing branch chains with tables

Status: accepted

Problem

Issue #2275 (epic #2221) lists seven functions above the complexity ceiling of 15. Four of them carry the debt: maskCodeLine (130), analyzeSourceUsage (96), isUsageMatcher (32), and javascriptImports (19). The other three — phpRequires, languageFor, moduleMatches — already measure 9, 1, and 8 on main after the #2226 split removed their entries, so they need no change here.

isUsageMatcher is exported from src/sdk.ts, the detector SDK, so this change touches a public contract file and needs a record even though the exported surface is unchanged.

Options compared

Option What it does Cost
Extract, keep the file Move the per-language literal scanner into src/usage/masking.ts; split the two long readers into named steps A new module and a new import edge
Table-driven dispatch Replace the language if chains with lookup tables keyed by language and by matcher shape Table definitions alongside the readers
Rewrite on tree-sitter Parse every language with the vendored WASM grammars instead of masking lines Slower, changes which usages are found, needs a grammar per edge case
Keep the chains, add a plugin registry Let each detector package register a masker Widens the SDK contract and moves the same branches behind a registry
Raise the ceiling or keep the allowlist rows Leave the debt Forbidden by AGENTS.md: an entry is a ceiling, never raised

Measurements

Complexity and length are read with the gate's own functionMeasures() (tools/check-quality.ts), on main at bb92ae76 and on this branch.

Function Before After
maskCodeLine (src/source-usage.ts → src/usage/masking.ts) complexity 130, 198 lines complexity 5, 10 lines
analyzeSourceUsage (src/source-usage.ts) complexity 96, 268 lines complexity 2, 7 lines
isUsageMatcher (src/sdk.ts) complexity 32, 52 lines complexity 7, 8 lines
javascriptImports (src/source-usage.ts) complexity 19, 63 lines complexity 5, 17 lines

The largest function now in src/usage/masking.ts measures complexity 11 and 26 lines, so no replacement entry is needed. src/source-usage.ts went from 795 to 709 lines and src/usage/masking.ts from 123 to 496.

Behavior is proved by a differential harness, not by inspection. It loads the shipped maskCodeLine from a clean build of bb92ae76 and the refactored one from this branch and compares them line by line, carrying a separate mask state per build, over 2,555 real repository files, 22 hand-written adversarial files, and 6,400 fuzzed files (400 per language × 16 languages, seeded PRNG): 4,328,416 masked lines identical, zero mismatches. The same harness runs analyzeSourceUsage over a multi-language fixture tree and over src/ and tests/, with and without the tree-sitter parser, and compares the full JSON: 6 runs identical (9,624 / 9,828 / 1,158 / 1,158 / 12,044 / 11,830 bytes). npm run check passes with the eight allowlist rows deleted.

Decision

  1. The line masker lives in src/usage/masking.ts. src/source-usage.ts is 795 lines on main, and the 800-line file gate fails any in-file split of maskCodeLine, so the scanner moves to its own module and source-usage.ts imports it. maskCodeLine keeps its signature and stays exported.
  2. Branch chains become tables. The masker walks a cursor through an ordered list of named steps; the import and call readers dispatch on a per-language table; isUsageMatcher dispatches on a per-shape predicate. Each table entry is a function with a name, so a failing language is one row, not one else if.
  3. The SDK contract does not change. src/sdk.ts keeps its 19 exports with the same signatures; only the validation body is restructured. A language or shape set is a named Set, so a new ecosystem is one line in the set that owns it.
  4. Debt is deleted, never moved. The four complexity rows and the four matching function-size rows are removed from benchmarks/quality-allowlist.json, and the two ESLint suppressions that no longer fire are pruned. No row, ceiling, any, or non-null assertion is added.

Why

  • A table names the case. 130 branches in one function cannot be reviewed; eleven steps of 10 to 26 lines can, and each is exercised by the masking tests in tests/source-usage-masking.test.ts.
  • The split is forced by a rule that already exists. The file-size gate, not taste, decides where the masker goes; keeping it in source-usage.ts would need an allowlist entry, which AGENTS.md forbids.
  • Parity evidence beats a green suite here. The masker's per-language quirks (Ruby percent literals, PHP and Ruby heredocs, C# verbatim strings, Swift multiline strings) are individually rare, so the differential corpus over 4.3M real and generated lines is the check that they still behave as before.

Consequences

  • src/usage/masking.ts is now the home for language literal rules; a new scanner language adds a step and a table row there rather than a branch in maskCodeLine.
  • src/usage/dynamic-references.ts imports the masker from its new path. Its own import of phpRequires/rubyInvocations from src/source-usage.ts stays, so the SDK-to-scanner edge is unchanged.
  • The three functions #2226 already fixed are left alone, and readRubyLiteral, rubyInvocations, and rubyKeywordIsCall stay allowlisted under #2276, which owns them.
  • The differential harness lives in /tmp, not in the repository. Rebuilding it costs a corpus run; the committed masking tests are the durable guard, and the harness was the one-time proof for this refactor.
